title: Wire EDM Deep Macro AI — Deep Learning, Deep Reasoning, Generative AI for Macros

units.title: Deep Learning for Macros domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 deep learning domains: wedm_macro_pattern_learning (sequence mining, n-gram), wedm_macro_structure_learning (grammar induction, tree-LSTM), wedm_macro_sequence_learning (LSTM/Transformer), wedm_macro_variable_learning (naming conventions), wedm_template_style_learning (style fingerprinting), wedm_parametric_feature_learning (regression, constraint learning), wedm_macro_anomaly_learning (isolation forest, autoencoder), wedm_program_embedding (Code2Vec, contrastive learning)

units.title: Deep Reasoning for Macros domains (8)
units.details: Added 8 deep reasoning domains: wedm_macro_causal_reasoning (causal DAGs, do-calculus), wedm_macro_constraint_reasoning (SAT/SMT, Z3), wedm_macro_what_if (Monte Carlo, sensitivity), wedm_macro_tradeoff_reasoning (Pareto, TOPSIS), wedm_macro_debugging_reasoning (FTA, delta debugging), wedm_macro_optimization_reasoning (NSGA-II, Bayesian), wedm_macro_abstraction_reasoning (subroutine decisions), wedm_macro_transfer_reasoning (cross-controller migration)

units.title: Generative AI for Macros domains (4)
units.details: Added 4 generative AI domains: wedm_macro_generation_llm (RAG, chain-of-thought), wedm_template_synthesis (VAE, neural synthesis), wedm_parametric_inference (symbolic regression, Eureqa/PySR), wedm_macro_code_completion (Transformer LM, copy mechanism)

units.title: Expert prompts for all 20 domains
units.details: Created Claude Opus-level expert prompts for each domain with: domain expertise framing, ML/AI methodology references, structured outputs, uncertainty quantification guidance

units.title: Tribal synthesis for all 20 domains
units.details: Added all 20 new domains to manufacturingDomains array for tribal knowledge injection from shop-floor macro programming experience

units.title: WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine integration
units.details: Extended ai_recommendations interface with 20 new fields. Added collectAIRecommendations() calls for all 20 domains. Added domains to validRecs array. Enhanced synthesis report with MACRO-DEEP summaries (8 key summaries).

units.title: Domain test suite
units.details: 43 tests covering: deep learning (16), deep reasoning (16), generative AI (8), tribal synthesis (3)

units.title: Integration test suite
units.details: 44 tests verifying all 20 domains are wired into pipeline: interface fields (20), collectAI calls (20), validRecs array (3), synthesis report (8)

domains: wedm_macro_pattern_learning — Sequence mining (PrefixSpan, GSP), n-gram analysis
wedm_macro_sequence_learning — LSTM/Transformer for G-code sequence generation
wedm_macro_variable_learning — Naming conventions, variable lifecycle analysis
wedm_program_embedding — Code2Vec, contrastive learning, similarity search
wedm_macro_what_if — Monte Carlo, sensitivity indices (Sobol, Morris)
wedm_macro_generation_llm — LLM-based macro generation with RAG
wedm_template_synthesis — VAE for template synthesis, neural synthesis
wedm_macro_code_completion — Transformer LM, copy mechanism, type-aware

ml_architectures.anomaly_detection: Isolation Forest, Autoencoder, One-class SVM, LOF
ml_architectures.optimization: NSGA-II, NSGA-III, Bayesian Optimization, Genetic Algorithms
ml_architectures.reasoning: SAT/SMT (Z3), Causal DAGs, Monte Carlo, Delta Debugging

integration_points.WEDMCompleteOrchestrationEngine: 20 new fields + collectAI calls + validRecs + synthesis summaries

summary: Deep Learning + Deep Reasoning + Generative AI for Wire EDM Macros. 20 new domains: Deep Learning (8 domains for pattern mining, sequence learning, embeddings), Deep Reasoning (8 domains for causal analysis, constraint solving, optimization), Generative AI (4 domains for LLM generation, template synthesis, code completion). All domains have expert prompts, tribal synthesis, AND full orchestration integration. 94 tests passing (43 domain + 44 integration + 7 other). Total WEDM AI domains: 126. Total WEDM AI tests: 311.
